role: Senior Software Engineer, through Mindgrub Technologies
dek: UMBC’s Maryland MIECHV home-visiting training site runs on Drupal 8 on Pantheon. It exposes content through GraphQL and OpenAPI with OAuth, builds pages from Paragraphs, and is covered by BackstopJS visual regression and Behat.
